title: 大直徑鑽掘豎井
summary: 大直徑豎井的進度由完整作業循環決定，不能只看切削機額定功率。本課把幾何開挖量、切削能、提升循環、工作盤反力與通風排水聯成系統，利用量測分辨設備瓶頸與地層限制，並以故障停機及永久襯砌介面建立可追溯的施工交接。
summaryEn: Large-shaft progress depends on the complete operating cycle rather than rated cutting power. The course links excavation volume, cutting energy, hoisting cycles, working-platform reactions, ventilation and drainage, uses measurements to separate equipment bottlenecks from ground constraints, and develops traceable handover through downtime and permanent-lining interfaces.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創教學例：圓井直徑D=10 m，每次進尺h=1 m，原位體積為V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。若直徑增加10%至11 m而進尺相同，V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³，增加21%。提升量若以鬆方記錄，必須先以實測鬆方係數換算，才可與此原位量比較。這項幾何敏感度不表示切削時間必然增加21%，因為岩性、刀具、出碴及支護還可能改變循環。施工團隊應把新增體積放入整個循環分析，而非只擴大切削功率。
workedExample.textEn: Original teaching example: for a circular shaft with D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume is V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. Increasing diameter by 10% to 11 m at the same advance gives V=π×11²×1/4=95.03 m³, an increase of 21%. Hoisted loose volume must first be converted using a measured bulking factor before comparison. This geometric sensitivity does not imply exactly 21% more cutting time because geology, tools, muck handling and support also shape the cycle. The construction team should insert the extra volume into the complete cycle model instead of simply increasing the installed cutting power alone.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」與「切削比能的機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Excavation section mechanism and verification" and "Cutting specific energy mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Excavation section mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開挖斷面」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Excavation section” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。名目井徑不是實際開挖輪廓，超挖及地層掉塊必須另外計量，才可建立可靠的物料平衡與施工循環。幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開挖斷面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space. Nominal shaft diameter is not the excavated profile; overbreak and falling blocks must be measured separately to establish a credible material balance and cycle. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Excavation section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開挖斷面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Excavation section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Nominal shaft diameter is not the excavated profile; overbreak and falling blocks must be measured separately to establish a credible material balance and cycle.

knowledge.text: 誤解：井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Excavation section mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。
大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。
切削機額定功率越大就一定有同比例的進尺。
optionsEn: A ten-percent diameter increase produces only ten-percent more excavation volume.
Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space.
Higher rated cutting power always gives proportionally higher advance.
quiz.explanation: 大直徑井每增加少量直徑，單位深度的開挖體積便按平方增加；出碴、襯砌與設備空間也隨之改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Even a small diameter increase raises excavation volume per unit depth quadratically, affecting muck handling, lining and equipment space. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Excavation section mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開挖斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Excavation section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：掃描各段斷面並核對標高，將原位體積與提升容器計量分列，使用實測鬆方係數比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Scan each lift and check elevations; distinguish in-situ volume from hoisted loose volume and compare them using a measured bulking factor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

quiz.question: 依「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Excavation section mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 四個支點在所有工況下必定各承受四分之一重量。
只要最終支護足夠厚，施工中裸露長度就不重要。
原創教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。
optionsEn: Four supports necessarily carry one quarter of the load in every condition.
Adequate final support thickness makes temporary exposed length unimportant.
Original teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：直徑D=10 m、進尺h=1 m，原位體積V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: For diameter D=10 m and advance h=1 m, in-situ volume V=πD²h/4=78.54 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Excavation section mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開挖斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Excavation section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 掃描各段斷面並核對標高，將原位體積與提升容器計量分列，使用實測鬆方係數比較。物料表須保留井深、掃描輪廓及體積定義，超挖量應交地工設計者判讀後調整支護。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Scan each lift and check elevations; distinguish in-situ volume from hoisted loose volume and compare them using a measured bulking factor. Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：物料表須保留井深、掃描輪廓及體積定義，超挖量應交地工設計者判讀後調整支護。幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain depth, scanned profile and volume definitions in material records; the geotechnical designer reviews overbreak before support is revised. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把鬆方當原位方會誤判出碴效率，亦可能掩蓋局部超挖與井壁鬆動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing loose and in-situ volume distorts mucking efficiency and can conceal overbreak or shaft-wall loosening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Excavation section mechanism and verification"?

steps.title: 開挖斷面的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Excavation section mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開挖斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Excavation section” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把鬆方當原位方會誤判出碴效率，亦可能掩蓋局部超挖與井壁鬆動。幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing loose and in-situ volume distorts mucking efficiency and can conceal overbreak or shaft-wall loosening. Geometry does not predict cuttability, and loose broken rock is not automatically ground loss; normalize the volume basis and measurement location before comparing production. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：幾何計算不預測切削難度，也不能把破碎岩塊的鬆方直接當作地層流失；比較產量前須先統一體積基準與計量位置。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「井徑增加百分之十，開挖體積也只增加百分之十。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「開挖斷面的機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Excavation section mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把鬆方當原位方會誤判出碴效率，亦可能掩蓋局部超挖與井壁鬆動。

steps.instruction: 切削比能把破岩所需能量與開挖體積連結，可用來比較同一設備在不同岩層中的反應。刀具磨耗、岩石強度、節理和切入深度都會改變比能；額定電功率另含傳動損失，不能全部當成有效破岩功率。比能是狀態指標而非可通用的材料常數，必須注明量測位於馬達端或刀盤端，並保留效率與空轉扣除的方法。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「切削比能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 井底破岩後仍須把碴土送至地面，提升能力常隨井深增加而下降。完整循環包含裝載、加速、運送、卸載與回程，容器額定容量若未滿載或受限於重量便不能直接當有效體積。設備之間的等候時間也會消耗可用產能。此處是鬆方提升量，與切削原位量比較時要換算；雙容器或交錯作業會改變循環邏輯，不能直接相加額定值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「提升循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Broken rock must still reach the surface, and hoisting capacity often falls as shaft depth increases. The full cycle includes loading, acceleration, travel, unloading and return. Rated bucket volume is not useful volume when fill is incomplete or weight governs, while waiting between subsystems consumes available capacity. This is loose-volume hoisting capacity and requires conversion before comparison with in-situ cutting; twin-bucket or overlapping operations change cycle logic, so ratings cannot simply be added. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hoisting cycle” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water inflow buffer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 井底集水與排水系統必須在湧水變動及設備停機期間保持可用空間。平均湧水量只能估算短時累積，裂隙連通或承壓層突破會使流量突然改變；泵浦曲線、排放背壓與備援供電共同決定可排出的實際水量。這是固定流量的儲水量估算，不包含突湧峰值或自由空間損失；容量分析必須扣除沉積物、泵浦與不可用高度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「湧水緩衝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sump and pumping systems must preserve working space during changing inflow and equipment outages. Mean inflow estimates short-term accumulation only; connected fractures or penetration of a pressurized aquifer can change flow abruptly. Pump curves, discharge backpressure and backup power jointly determine actual removal rather than nameplate capacity alone. This fixed-flow storage estimate excludes surge inflow and lost free space; capacity analysis must subtract sediment, equipment displacement and unusable depth. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water inflow buffer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: System bottleneck mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統瓶頸」如何影響大直徑鑽掘豎井的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System bottleneck” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-diameter bored-shaft excavation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 串聯施工系統中最慢的必要工序限制穩態產量，暫存空間只能吸收短時波動，不能永久消除瓶頸。提升能力充足但支護落後時，加快切削只會增加井底堆積與裸露時間；改良一個工序後，限制也可能轉移到另一環節。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統瓶頸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a serial construction system, the slowest required process limits steady throughput; buffers absorb short fluctuations but cannot remove a permanent bottleneck. If support lags despite adequate hoisting, faster cutting merely increases bottom accumulation and exposure. Improving one activity can transfer the constraint to another subsystem, so interventions must be assessed across the complete cycle. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System bottleneck” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：全部換成原位等值後，切削90、提升120、支護70 m³/h，理想穩態Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: On one in-situ-equivalent basis, cutting, hoisting and support capacities are 90, 120 and 70 m³/h; ideal steady Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統瓶頸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System bottleneck”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System bottleneck mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每個工序的額定產量相加就是整體施工產量。
串聯施工系統中最慢的必要工序限制穩態產量，暫存空間只能吸收短時波動，不能永久消除瓶頸。

optionsEn: Adding the rated capacities of all activities gives system throughput.

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System bottleneck mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統瓶頸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System bottleneck” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：全部換成原位等值後，切削90、提升120、支護70 m³/h，理想穩態Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: On one in-situ-equivalent basis, cutting, hoisting and support capacities are 90, 120 and 70 m³/h; ideal steady Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h. This calculation checks scale and units; it is not a site acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：全部換成原位等值後，切削90、提升120、支護70 m³/h，理想穩態Q=min(90,120,70)=70 m³/h。此式用於量級與單位檢查，並非現場允收值。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System bottleneck mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 提升速度與容器容量足以單獨決定實際日產量。

A vertical guidance display removes the need for independent survey checks.

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System bottleneck mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統瓶頸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System bottleneck” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊工序時間戳與體積基準，追蹤排隊長度、暫存量及支護完成深度，確認最慢環節是否持續存在。日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align activity clocks and volume bases, then track queues, buffer volumes and completed-support depth to determine whether the apparent bottleneck persists. Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：日報應把各工序等值產量與等待原因並列；任何增產方案由施工及臨時工程設計者共同審查支護與緩衝容量。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Daily reports show equivalent activity outputs beside waiting causes; construction and temporary-works leads jointly review support and buffer capacity for any production increase. The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A larger cutter alone may increase cost without improving throughput while overloading the planned support and drainage coordination. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統瓶頸的機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System bottleneck mechanism and verification"?

steps.title: 系統瓶頸的機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System bottleneck mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統瓶頸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System bottleneck” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只購置更大切削設備可能增加成本而不增加產量，並讓支護與排水超出原先協調能力。最小值模型適用於簡化串聯系統，實際並行工序、變異與停機會降低達成值；不得把理想瓶頸產能當作現場承諾。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

The minimum model applies to a simplified serial system; parallel activities, variability and outages affect achieved output, so ideal bottleneck capacity is not a field commitment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
